deals.whyRanked: Allegiant lists $60 BOS→FLL on Nov 14 and $52 FLL→BOS on Dec 3 — about $112 round trip (up from $104 yesterday as the $44 return slipped to $52), still the cheapest verified fare, with the Everglades 50 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: The free Sun Trolley links the beach and Las Olas without a car, and the lit beachfront promenade stays comfortable for a solo evening walk.

highlights: Shark Valley's flat 15-mile Everglades bike loop
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, water taxi to Las Olas, sunset on the beach promenade.
Day 2 — Early drive to Shark Valley for the tram or bike loop; gators are easiest to spot in the dry-season morning.
Day 3 — Bonnet House gardens, then brunch on the Riverwalk before the flight.
guide.gettingAround: Sun Trolley and water taxis cover downtown and the beach; rent a car for one day only, for the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: Near Las Olas or the beach — both walkable to dining and trolley stops.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant shows $56 BOS→TYS on Nov 14 and $68 TYS→BOS on Nov 19 ($76 on Dec 3) — about $124–132 round trip, down from $132, with the Smokies 45 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, walkable downtown with a greenway system, plus an easy solo day in the Smokies.

highlights: Great Smoky Mountains via the Townsend entrance
Knoxville Urban Wilderness trails (Ijams Nature Center)
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Old City, then the Sunsphere at dusk.
Day 2 — Drive to Townsend for Cades Cove loop and an easy waterfall hike.
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center trails and the river greenway before the flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable, but you need a rental car for the Smokies; TYS is about 15 minutes from the city center.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square, walkable to food, bars, and the trolley.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 10 – Nov 16 (JetBlue round trip); other Nov dates $95+ each way
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue shows a $134 round trip Nov 10–16, with Southwest and JetBlue one-ways from $95 in early November; Tampa Bay beaches and Fort De Soto make it an easy sun-and-nature solo trip.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Riverwalk and Water Street, cheap streetcar and ferry links, and easy beach day trips.

highlights: Tampa Riverwalk from Armature Works to the Straz Center
Fort De Soto Park beaches and fort
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, check in downtown, walk the Riverwalk and have dinner at Armature Works.
Day 2 — Drive to Fort De Soto for beach, kayaking and the old fort; sunset at St. Pete Pier.
Day 3 — Ybor City Cuban sandwich and cigar-rolling history, then the airport.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with the TECO streetcar to Ybor; rent a car (or rideshare) for one beach day.
guide.stayArea: Downtown/Channelside or Water Street — walkable to the Riverwalk with plenty of mid-range hotels.
food: Columbia Restaurant in Ybor City (Cuban sandwich)
Bernini or Rooster & the Till for a splurge dinner

deals.whyRanked: Southwest shows $59 BOS→BWI on Nov 10 with returns around $86 — about $145–175 round trip, down from $172+; solo-friendly harbor city with Assateague a 2.5-hour drive.
deals.soloWhy: Light rail and water taxis connect the harbor neighborhoods, and the museums are cheap or free.

highlights: Inner Harbor and the National Aquarium
itinerary: Day 1 — Inner Harbor and water taxi to Fells Point.
Day 2 — American Visionary Art Museum, then Federal Hill at sunset.
Day 3 — Patapsco Valley State Park hike before the flight.
guide.gettingAround: Light rail runs from BWI to downtown; water taxis and the free Charm City Circulator cover the core.
guide.stayArea: Fells Point or Harbor East for walkable dining and the waterfront.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue shows $90 BOS→MCO on Oct 24 and Southwest from $95 on Nov 3 — roughly $185–217 round trip ($217 JetBlue Nov 24–28); Winter Park keeps it solo-friendly and Wekiwa Springs is a short drive.
deals.soloWhy: Winter Park is walkable with scenic boat tours and a SunRail stop, away from the theme-park crowds.

itinerary: Day 1 — Winter Park Park Avenue stroll and the scenic boat tour.
Day 2 — Wekiwa Springs kayak or swim, then Lake Eola at dusk.
Day 3 — Morse Museum before the flight.
guide.gettingAround: SunRail links downtown and Winter Park; a rental car is needed for Wekiwa and the seashore.
guide.stayArea: Winter Park near Park Avenue, walkable and calmer than the tourist corridor.
